message_types.name: MASclTrigger
message_types.description: Universal ingress trigger that activates all multi-paradigm agents (CEL, REST, AI, BPR) across the mesh

properties.name: trigger_id
properties.description: Unique UUID or identifier for the trigger event

properties.name: source
properties.description: Source initiating the trigger (e.g. operator, simulator, scheduler)

properties.name: notes
properties.description: Optional metadata or trigger payload notes

message_types.name: MASclOcurrence
message_types.description: Standardized occurrence message emitted by all 4 agent paradigms upon periodic cron or reactive trigger execution

properties.name: occurrence_id
properties.description: Unique identifier of this occurrence run

properties.name: agent_type
properties.description: Execution paradigm of the emitting agent (CEL, REST, AI, BPR)

properties.name: agent_name
properties.description: Logical name or reactor ID of the emitting agent

properties.name: node_id
properties.description: Mesh node ID where the agent executed

properties.name: status
properties.description: Execution status code (e.g. OK, SUCCESS, NOMINAL)

properties.name: details
properties.description: Descriptive execution summary or model output
